Test Case Description: Dependencies/Pre-requisite :
The User Authentication Module must be implemented to ensure only authenticated users can access the system.
The Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) configuration must be available to enforce permissions for each role.
A Global Settings Rule database structure must exist to store rule configurations.
Backend services or APIs must be available to retrieve rule data for the listing page.
Navigation configuration must include the Global Settings page in the application menu.
